A Flavorful Mexican Experience in DN
Apr 2025 • Friends
Tacos Danang offers a delightful taste of Mexican cuisine right in the heart of Da Nang. Located at 72/17 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, this cozy eatery is known for its vibrant and flavorful dishes. The menu features a variety of options, including tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and nachos, all of which can be customized to suit vegetarian or vegan preferences. Banging
Jul 2024 • Solo
I dont usually write reviews as I always forget (boo).. However, I went here a couple of months ago and I have not stopped thinking about their tacos since. I have tried countless tacos and on my quest I have not found anything that lives up to their deliciousness. 
They're not huge, you order one at a time so they're warm. But wowowoe what they lack in size they make up in flavour, I had around 4 or 5 tacos each time a few days in a row. I only eat fish so I had the fish ones and tried all the sauces, my recommendation is the ginger and wasabi. Even if ginger isn't your thing it's not overpowering and just incredible. I'm booking my flight back to Da nang just to have these again, for real. Lame, yes? Worth it? Also yes.

Home cooked fresh tacos
Jul 2024 • Family
Super fresh, homemade tacos filled with delicious sauces and salads. Don't expect a huge menu, you come here for super tasty, simple tacos which are both delicious and great value. You choose from 4 base fillings (chicken/pork/fish/veg) and 4 toppings. We loved the chicken and fish with ginger/lime, plus the pork with tamarind BBQ - OK, we enjoyed everything we ordered. Staggeringly good value for money - delicious food, served by kind and friendly people. We've been twice already and will return!
